description: Michigan motorcycle delta: helmet law and lane rules. National riding skills stay in core_motorcycle.json.

questions.q: A Michigan rider who is age 21 or older
options: Must wear one on every trip
questions.explanation: The Michigan age rule is aimed at riders 20 and younger. Some states add a novice or insurance condition, so read the statute before riding without a helmet.

questions.q: What does Michigan law say about riding a motorcycle between lanes of traffic?
options: Riding between lanes of traffic is not allowed
Only lane filtering is allowed, when traffic is stopped or slow
questions.explanation: Michigan: riding between lanes of traffic is not allowed.

provenance.manual: Traffic Laws FAQs - Michigan State Police

questions.q: What does Michigan require for a motorcycle rider's eye protection?
options: Required unless the motorcycle has a windshield
questions.explanation: Michigan: eye protection is required unless the motorcycle has a windshield.
questions.remember: Michigan eyewear: required unless there is a windshield.

questions.q: In Michigan, what is the youngest age for a motorcycle learner's permit?
questions.explanation: Michigan issues a motorcycle permit at 16 years at the earliest.
questions.remember: Michigan motorcycle permit: 16 years at the earliest.
